description: This PHP source file defines the ViewSearchProperties class, which extends ViewList, responsible for handling the display and processing of search properties within the Connectors module of SuiteCRM. It includes methods to process options and render a view with connector and module data, including fetching connector strings and source definitions.

classes.name: ViewSearchProperties
classes.description: A class extending ViewList, responsible for processing options and rendering the search properties view in the Connectors module.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Sets display options (hide header/footer, show javascript) and delegates to the parent process method.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Loads necessary connector utils and source factory, prepares display data for enabled connectors and fields, and renders the search properties template.
